name: Action Type 6 Code
definition: Type of action to be performed.

DCCQ.name: Accept Currency Conversion
DCCQ.definition: Ask the cardholder to accept the currency conversion.

DISP.name: Display Message
DISP.definition: Message to display, print or log.

CPNS.name: Distribute Coupon
CPNS.definition: Distribute a coupon from the cassette of coupon.

RQST.name: Perform Request
RQST.definition: Request to be performed by the ATM.

PINR.name: PIN Retry
PINR.definition: PIN (Personal Identification Number) is wrong, retry a PIN verification.

TRCK.name: Update Track
TRCK.definition: Track provided in the response must be updated on the card.
